name: clean-cli-engine-koala-branding
title: Clean Koala branding remnants from CLI engine
description: Audit packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts and generated dist output for Koala branding remnants after the package-scope rename. Replace user-visible current-product wording with Lattice while preserving explicitly legacy compatibility identifiers such as koala command alias, koala.config.json fallback, koala-codex fallback, and koala-review-* lane IDs. Use a Claude CLI agent for implementation inside the Lattice story worktree, then verify build, runtime checks, and focused Koala-reference classification.
